next.reason: 1985: 'Implementors will specify, for their compilers, all details on how the other language(s) are to be written.'; 2023: 'No ENTER statement in 2023; no candidate covers other-language text written within COBOL source'. 2023 has no ENTER statement clause. Candidates cover inter-language calls and pointers only, not other-language code written in a COBOL program, so the rule is gone.
